tldr: 台股中秋連假前最後交易日（9/24）收在48,024點、跌約0.28%，權值股台積電逆勢漲1%，連假期間休市。
SEMICON Taiwan盛會與台積電營收指引使AI、半導體續居市場核心，但建廠人力與機台交期瓶頸凸顯執行面風險。
金管會為壽險業接軌TIS新制、迎接9月底資本大考鬆綁過渡措施；亞洲資產管理中心與主動式ETF延續財管動能。

items.title_zh: 台股連假前量縮收黑、台積電逆勢走高
items.summary_zh: 台股於中秋連假前最後交易日（9/24）以48,024.60點作收、跌約0.28%，權值股台積電逆勢上漲1%至2,475元。連假期間台股休市，加權指數維持此一水準進入新一週，投資人靜待節後資金與AI題材的動向。
items.summary_en: **Taipei bourse shut for Mid-Autumn holiday after a soft final session.** The TAIEX finished its last pre-holiday trading day on Sept 24 at 48,024.60, down about 0.28%, while TSMC bucked the trend to close up 1% at NT$2,475. With trading suspended through the Mid-Autumn Festival break, the benchmark carries this level into the new week as investors await post-holiday flows.

items.title_zh: 台積電有望成2026年最大贏家
items.summary_zh: 台積電管理階層對2026年全年營收給出約三成成長指引，並預期AI相關營收至2029年將以近60%的年複合成長率擴張。AI建置需求持續驅動晶圓龍頭營運，也讓台積電穩居全球半導體循環與台股行情核心。
items.summary_en: **TSMC shapes up as 2026's quiet winner on relentless AI demand.** Management guides for revenue growth of roughly 30% in 2026 and expects AI-related revenue to compound at close to 60% annually through 2029. The outlook underscores how the AI build-out keeps the foundry leader at the center of the global chip cycle and Taiwan's equity story heading into the new week.

items.title_zh: SEMICON Taiwan盛會聚焦AI、矽光子與先進封裝
items.summary_zh: 半導體年度盛會SEMICON Taiwan 2026登場，參展廠商達1,300家、4,300個攤位雙創新高，大師論壇首度全天舉行。議題橫跨雲端算力、HBM記憶體、高速互連與先進封裝，凸顯台灣自晶圓製造向封裝、測試、材料與設備的完整AI硬體供應鏈延伸。
items.summary_en: **SEMICON Taiwan 2026 spotlights AI, silicon photonics and advanced packaging.** The island's flagship semiconductor showcase drew a record 1,300 exhibitors across 4,300 booths, with the Executive Forum running a full day for the first time. Sessions spanned cloud compute, HBM memory, high-speed interconnects and advanced packaging, framing Taiwan's expansion from wafer fabrication into the full AI hardware supply chain.

items.title_zh: 台積電示警建廠人力與機台交期瓶頸
items.summary_zh: 台積電侯永清指出，整體生態系尚未準備好因應全球建廠潮，營造人力短缺成為限制之一，機台設備需求半年內翻倍，導致供應商供貨吃緊。此番談話點出AI帶動的資本支出循環背後，仍存在建廠與設備交期等執行面風險。
items.summary_en: **TSMC flags construction and equipment bottlenecks behind the global fab boom.** Executive Y.C. Hou said the ecosystem is not fully prepared for the worldwide wave of new plants: skilled construction labor is scarce and tool demand has doubled within six months, leaving equipment suppliers unable to keep pace. The comments highlight the execution risks lurking behind the AI-driven capital-spending cycle.

items.title_zh: 金管會鬆綁過渡措施助壽險接軌TIS
items.summary_zh: 因應壽險業由RBC接軌新一代清償能力制度TIS，金管會核准過渡措施，讓8家以壽險為主體的金控資本壓力大減，並准許11家金控延後一個月申報資本適足率，以緩解新舊資本標準轉換的衝擊，協助業者平順接軌以「自有資本÷風險資本」計算的新制。
items.summary_en: **FSC grants transitional capital relief as insurers adopt the new TIS regime.** Under the shift to the new solvency system replacing RBC, regulators approved measures easing capital pressure for eight insurance-focused financial-holding groups and let eleven holding companies defer their capital-adequacy filings by a month. The steps smooth the transition to the tougher own-capital-over-risk-capital standard now taking effect.

items.title_zh: 壽險9月底TIS資本首考可望全數過關
items.summary_zh: 壽險業首份TIS期中資本申報須於9月底完成，金管會祭出兩項穩定資本措施協助業者達標，市場普遍預期本次首考可望全數過關。此次大考是檢視壽險業資本韌性的重要關卡，攸關後續接軌新制與商品策略的調整空間。
items.summary_en: **Life insurers head into their end-September TIS capital test likely to pass.** The first interim TIS report is due by the end of September, and the FSC has deployed two stabilising measures so insurers can meet the threshold, with the sector widely expected to clear the maiden test. The exercise is a key checkpoint for the industry's capital resilience under the new framework.

items.title_zh: 安聯投信推2026首檔台股主動式ETF
items.summary_zh: 安聯投信推出2026年首檔台股主動式ETF，並由LINE Bank擔任全台唯一獨家預購通路，擴大投資人參與主動選股策略的管道。此檔產品反映台灣投資人對主動式ETF興趣升溫，尋求在被動指數型商品之外爭取超額報酬的資產配置需求。
items.summary_en: **Allianz Global Investors launches its first actively managed Taiwan-equity ETF for 2026.** The new active ETF debuts with LINE Bank as the exclusive channel for pre-orders across Taiwan, widening retail access to actively managed equity strategies. The launch reflects growing appetite among Taiwanese investors for active ETFs that seek alpha beyond passive index products in their asset allocation.

items.title_zh: 亞洲資產管理中心提前達標、高資產成引擎
items.summary_zh: 政府2024年啟動的亞洲資產管理中心政策，透過五大計畫與跨部會協作，資產管理規模已於2025年底提前達成兩年政策目標。高資產財富管理仍是推升規模的核心引擎，金管會並放寬銀行對資產達新台幣1億元以上客戶提供多元商品與諮詢服務的條件。
items.summary_en: **Taiwan's Asia asset-management hub push hits its two-year AUM goal early.** The government's asset-management centre initiative, launched in 2024 with five programmes and cross-agency coordination, saw managed assets reach the policy's two-year target ahead of schedule by end-2025. High-net-worth wealth management remains a core engine, with regulators easing rules for clients holding over NT$100m in assets.
